page_title: ROM 5-0 PAR | AS Roma v Parma 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The match has just finished.

90+1' Dennis Man (Parma) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Mile Svilar has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. Good work from Parma as they win a corner.
89' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.

89' What a poor attempt! Simon Sohm (Parma) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
86' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:9.
83' 5 - 0 A skilful piece of play and pass by Paulo Dybala leaves the keeper on his backside and presents Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) with the easiest goal you'll ever see into an unguarded net. 5:0.
82' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
80' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' AS Roma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
79' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

79' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 58:42.
78' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
74' 4 - 0 Goal! Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Zion Suzuki to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
73' It's a penalty! AS Roma have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.

72' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
71' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Lautaro Valenti (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for AS Roma.
70' Substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny walks off the pitch and Valentin Mihaila (Parma) comes on as a substitute.
69' That's unlucky! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
68' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Paulo Dybala picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.

67' Drissa Camara (Parma) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the crossbar. Aim better, sir. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
64' Angelino (AS Roma) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
64' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Angelino (AS Roma).
63' Dennis Man (Parma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Parma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
61' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) sends a low pass into the box, towards Manu Kone. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
61' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
59' Today's match ends for Emanuele Valeri who will be replaced by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
54' Fabio Pecchia decides to make a substitution. Enrico Del Prato will be replaced by Lautaro Valenti (Parma).
54' Substitution. Pontus Almqvist is replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Parma).
54' Referee Marco Di Bello points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes wild in celebration.
53' Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' 3 - 0 Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets control of the ball in the penalty area and finds the top left corner of the goal with a technically-perfect strike!
50' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Pontus Almqvist (Parma) for his blatant foul.

49' Manu Kone (AS Roma) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
48' 5:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
47' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
46' Substitution. Anas Haj Mohamed leaves the pitch and is replaced by Drissa Camara (Parma).
46' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
44' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
43' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
42' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
40' Parma keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
39' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
38' Dennis Man (Parma) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.

36' Anas Haj Mohamed is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Hernani (Parma). The ball is cleared after Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

35' Hernani (Parma) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
33' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) fails to beat the offside trap. The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle.
33' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

31' Pontus Almqvist rounds off a good move with a layoff to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
30' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a good run to meet a precise cross just outside the box. He latches on to it and strikes the ball, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
29' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
28' Zion Suzuki produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper.
26' Angelino (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is behind the touchline and AS Roma will take a throw-in.
23' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
23' Poor challenge! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) is penalised for tripping and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle.
22' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

22' What a great effort! Emanuele Valeri (Parma) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
21' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
20' Ball possession – 62:38.
19' Parma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

19' Hernani (Parma) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Parma get a corner.
18' Marco Di Bello blows the whistle, Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
17' Simon Sohm (Parma) tries to find Pontus Almqvist, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
16' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Parma.
15' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Di Bello signals. A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
13' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Angelino plays it into the box, and Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:0.
12' Dennis Man (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
11' Manu Kone (AS Roma) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
10' Neat passing move from AS Roma in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Zion Suzuki no chance!
8' Referee Marco Di Bello sees the trip by Botond Balogh (Parma) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. AS Roma are given a penalty!

6' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Angelino. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
5' Stephan El Shaarawy receives a sweet cross inside the box from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
4' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

3' What a chance that is! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
1' AS Roma keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
